'''Feswe Prime''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
This unstable [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] was subject to periodic stellar flare eruptions.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:ExecutorFeswe-CSW.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] fires on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fleet.]]
In the effort to evacuate [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] found a stable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] from the [[Feswe Corridor]] to [[Hynah]]. The route was rejected as too dangerous, but [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to lead the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] past Feswe Prime, and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff|Griff's]] foolhardy attack prevented the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] from cutting off the Rebels' escape.<ref name="TEA" />
